description:
### Workflow for microbial (meta-)genome annotation

Input is a (meta)genome sequence in fasta format.

* bakta
* KoFamScan (optional)
* InterProScan (optional)
* eggNOG mapper (optional)

* To RDF conversion with SAPP (optional, default on) --> [SAPP conversion Workflow in WorkflowHub](https://workflowhub.eu/workflows/1174/)

git: [https://gitlab.com/m-unlock/cwl](https://gitlab.com/m-unlock/cwl)
name: Microbial (meta-) genome annotation
tools: compress files when compression is true
gather files when compression is false
move all bakta files to a folder
